newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's Eastern Water to launch IPO.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Eastern Water to launch IPO.

text.p: Thailand's Eastern Water Resources Development and Management Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would make an initial public offering of 51 million shares next month.

Eastern Water said 15-to-20 percent of the total increased shares would be offered on a road show abroad and 10 percent to employees of the state agencies including the Provincial Waterworks Authority (PWA) and the Industrial Estate Authority of Thailand.
It said the other 70 percent of the shares would be offered to the public.

PWA set up Eastern Water in 1993 after a cabinet decision. As a private company, it develops and manages the water distribution system and water resources to industries and provincial communities in the government-sponsored Eastern Seaboard Development Programme.
